bi_rate_note: BI cut 25bps to 5.50% in May 2026. Further cuts expected in H2 2026 if IDR stabilizes. Lower rates support property and dividend stocks.
idr_note: IDR stabilized around 16,300-16,500 range in May 2026 after Q1 weakness. BI intervention and improving trade balance limiting further depreciation.
foreign_flow_note: Cumulative $2.8B net foreign outflow YTD 2026. Broad EM de-risking continues but pace slowing vs Q1. Domestic retail buying partially absorbing outflows.
global_sentiment_note: Global risk sentiment cautious but not panicking. EM asset class facing headwinds from strong DXY and elevated US yields. Indonesia specific: domestic consumption holding up.
vix_note: VIX around 20-24 range, elevated vs 2024 lows. Not crisis-level but reflects persistent uncertainty. Elevated VIX typically pressures EM valuations and foreign flows.
fed_note: Fed held at 4.50% through May 2026. Market pricing 1-2 cuts in H2 2026. Any Fed cut is a strong tailwind for EM equities and IDR stability.
dxy_note: DXY around 104-106. Strong dollar is the primary headwind for IDR and EM capital flows. Any DXY reversal would be a significant catalyst for IDX re-rating.
em_fund_flows_note: EM equity funds seeing modest outflows YTD. Indonesia among the more resilient EM markets due to commodity exports and domestic demand, but not immune to global risk-off.

commodity_context.gold_note: Gold near all-time highs, supporting gold/mineral stocks. Safe-haven demand elevated.
commodity_context.coal_note: Thermal coal prices declining from 2023 highs as energy transition accelerates. IDX coal stocks under structural pressure.
commodity_context.cpo_note: Palm oil prices stable around MYR 3,800-4,200/tonne. Supports Indonesian agribusiness and biodiesel mandates.
commodity_context.nickel_note: Nickel prices under pressure from Indonesian HPAL supply surge. Downstream EV battery thesis still intact long-term.

indonesia_specific.fdi_note: FDI realization Q1 2026 up 12% YoY. China+1 strategy benefiting Indonesian industrial estates (kawasan industri). DMAS, KIJA, BEST direct beneficiaries.
indonesia_specific.election_note: Prabowo administration (2024-2029) in governing phase. Infrastructure and FDI promotion policies supportive of industrial estate developers.
indonesia_specific.inflation_note: CPI 2.8% YoY in April 2026, within BI target band of 1.5-3.5%. Low inflation supports real purchasing power and BI rate cuts.

key_events: Fed meeting June 18 — hold expected, but statement tone critical for EM sentiment
BI rate decision June 2026 — possible 25bps cut if IDR holds 16,300-16,400
Indonesia Q1 2026 GDP release — consensus 5.1% YoY growth
US-China trade relations — key risk for FDI flows into Indonesian manufacturing hubs
Global industrial relocation (China+1) continues — direct catalyst for kawasan industri
